purpose: Test frozen CoverageDLGN V3 on deeper published dense architectures after the two-layer compact ladder failed to promote.

64k.source: From MNIST to ImageNet: Understanding the Scalability Boundaries of Differentiable Logic Gate Networks, baseline configuration and Table 12

256k.source: Fitting Multilinear Polynomials for Logic Gate Networks, Table 1 and Appendix E.1

local_selection.promotion_rule: Advance an architecture to its paper-length schedule only if the paired three-seed mean best hardened validation gain over random is positive.
local_selection.heldout_test_policy: Do not use the native CIFAR-100 test set during screening or confirmation. Evaluate it once only after the winner is frozen and trained at the paper-length schedule.

known_protocol_distinctions: The 64K and 256K coordinates intentionally retain their papers' different input encodings and GroupSum temperatures.
The multilinear paper evaluates the held-out test set repeatedly. The local study instead creates a validation split for selection to prevent test leakage.

The multilinear paper uses locality-preserving stride wiring. The central local causal comparison is fixed random wiring versus frozen CoverageDLGN V3; the reported Soft-Mix number is therefore a reported-only reference rather than an exact topology-matched baseline.
